thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired (P1) — embedder-prod-eu high 5xx rate. Trigger: /v1/embeddings error spike. Pager: @eng-oncall-eu. PD: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-84321

jordan: ack'd — I'm on it, joining bridge now.

maria: oncall pinged, standing by to take over if needed.

jordan: quick triage: dashboards show 30% 5xx on embedder endpoint, latency tail increased. Error logs show OOMKilled on 2 pods in the last 8m.

sam: I see the same. k8s events show OOMKill -> restart loop. suspect memory regression from last model rollout (embedder-v3-quant).

jordan: running mitigations: scaling to 4 replicas and triggering rolling restart: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/embedder --replicas=4 && kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/embedder`

maria: I'll begin a traffic-shed for heavy-batched requests to reduce pressure. patching route: `trafficctl route set embedder --max-batch-size 64`

jordan: adding fallback: route ~> embedder-v2-fp16 for requests > 1k tokens. Executed `route apply canary:fallback`.

sam: monitoring PD escalation timer. If 5xx > 10% after 10m, PD will escalate.

maria: status update — after scale+fallback, 5xx dropped to ~6% and falling. CPU/memory on new pods stable.

jordan: logs snippet (from restarted pod):
```
2026-03-17T18:12:04Z ERROR runtime: out of memory allocating workspace
2026-03-17T18:12:05Z KERN: OOMKilled
2026-03-17T18:12:06Z INFO init: warmup complete
```

sam: thanks. I'll mark the PD incident acknowledged and keep watch on the bridge for 30m.

jordan: handoff — @maria taking ownership for next 30m to observe and coordinate customer comms if needed. I'm going offline for a deploy.

maria: taking owner duty. immediate actions: (1) keep fallback active, (2) drain heavy batchers to canary, (3) collect memory profiles for failed pods. If stable at 30m I'll hand back.

sam: recommend notifying the top 5 customers who had elevated latency via PSAT if we still see >3% errors in 20m.

maria: noted. drafting short customer PSAT: "We observed an intermittent embeddings degradation affecting large batched requests; mitigation applied; working on root cause. Will update in 30m."

jordan: added runbook note + ticket RW-INC-2026 to track follow-up (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-INC-2026).

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PD incident PD-84321 acknowledged by jordan; owner changed to maria. Auto-suppress duplicate pages for 10m.

maria: current: error rate ~2.1%, tail latency improved. keeping owner. will post final status in ~25m. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll keep the alert window open and watch for regressions.

maria: (30m) steady. lowering urgency, preparing handback to normal oncall. final note: probable memory regression tied to quantization path; follow-up: revert quant rollout and add memory circuit-breaker.

incident-bot: :information_source: Incident PD-84321 status -> stable, owner=maria, duration=35m. If anything flares, PD will re-fire.
